title: Grow KaTeX transform library foundation
summary: Expand the current fixture taxonomy into reusable transform definitions for fractions, radicals, exponents, functions, logs/trig, distribution/factoring, matrices, sums, products, integrals, limits, accents, bars, norms, and absolute values.

sourceRefs.summary: Current authored KaTeX transform fixtures and sample taxonomy.
Animation sample catalogue surfaced in the editor/dashboard.
Existing artifact lifecycle helpers for non-token visual pieces such as radicals and brackets.
KaTeX token identity and DOM snapshot machinery that constrains transform definitions.
Token snapshot tests covering KaTeX DOM identity extraction.
Browser regression suite for visible KaTeX animation samples.

expectedLearning: Which unusual KaTeX geometries need distinct semantic transform definitions versus reusable visual motif parameters.
How to preserve identity for tokens, wrappers, operators, radicals, brackets, fractions, scripts, and matrix entries across authored transitions.
allowedWork: Extend the fixture/schema vocabulary to declare semantic transform intent, identity provenance, artifact policies, and default visual motifs.
Add representative transform definitions for fractions, radicals, exponents, functions, matrices, integrals, limits, sums/products, and wrappers.
Keep samples searchable and testable through the existing animation catalogue.
disallowedWork: Do not attempt full arbitrary LaTeX parsing as part of this slice.
Do not add new WebGL particle effects unless they are already represented by the shared motif API.
Do not change the dashboard layout beyond catalogue data needed to expose the new transforms.
